scenes.heading: STOP AI SLOP IN YOUR *DESIGNS*
scenes.say: AI generated design is everywhere, and it all looks the same. Hallmark is a design skill that fights the slop.

scenes.heading: hallmark
scenes.say: It's called hallmark. It's a design skill for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex. It teaches your AI what good design looks like, and what slop looks like.

scenes.heading: HOW IT WORKS
scenes.say: It's a CSS-based skill file. Drop it into your AI coding tool, and now your AI has a design conscience. It will reject generic gradients, reject stock layouts, and push for intentional choices.

scenes.heading: 40,796 ★ AND GROWING
scenes.say: Forty thousand stars. The anti-slop movement is real. Developers are tired of AI generating the same cookie-cutter design.

scenes.heading: INSTALL IN SECONDS
scenes.say: One file. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex. No dependencies, no npm install. Just add it to your project.

scenes.heading: THE HONEST CATCH
scenes.say: It's a skill file, not a design engine. Your AI still has to do the work. But hallmark gives it the vocabulary to know what's good and what's slop.
Is your AI generating designs that all look the same? Comment SLOP and follow for tools like this.
